long_biography.plain_text:
For security entrepreneur Jørgen Philip-Sørensen, the guard at the client's door was central to the business. His training school at Broadway taught newcomers and experienced managers both security practice and management. He also campaigned for licensing of Britain's private security industry, seeking formal standards for work often judged by its frontline staff.

His involvement in ocean racing was similarly sustained. After meeting skipper Mike Golding through a corporate sponsorship, he continued financing successive campaigns through his businesses and owned Golding's racing company. He followed its spending closely, combining enthusiasm for the sport with attention to the practical costs of keeping a professional team afloat.
